findings.ac: Summary text, headings and src fences are preserved; drawer-looking text inside a src block is preserved; an unterminated drawer is not removed.
findings.title: Drawers inside an unterminated #+begin_ block are still stripped
findings.detail: strip_drawers only skips a #+begin_… block when _block_end finds its #+end_. If the block is unterminated, any drawer or planning lines inside it are stripped. The Design says lines inside src/example blocks are 'never touched', but the docstring scopes this to terminated blocks. This only matters for malformed org, and it matches how from_org_body treats unterminated blocks.

ac_assessment.ac: `wt spec new --from-idea` on an idea with a `:PROPERTIES:` drawer and a `:LOGBOOK:` CLOCK entry produces a Context without `:PROPERTIES:`, `:LOGBOOK:`, `:END:`, `:ID:` or `CLOCK:` lines.
ac_assessment.evidence: specs._idea_context now runs from_org_body(strip_drawers(...)). In tests/test_explore.py::test_promote_context_drops_drawers, a real idea gets a summary and is clocked in and out (the test asserts :LOGBOOK: is in the idea file), then scaffold_from_idea runs. The test asserts that none of :PROPERTIES:, :LOGBOOK:, :END:, :ID: or CLOCK: appears in the Context section. This is an end-to-end test with no mocking.

ac_assessment.ac: Summary text, `** Summary` / `** Log` headings and src fences are preserved; drawer-looking text inside a src block is preserved; an unterminated drawer is not removed.
ac_assessment.evidence: test_promote_context_drops_drawers asserts that 'Durable finding about X' and '** Summary' stay in the Context. test_org_markup.py::test_strip_drawers_removes_drawers_and_planning checks the exact output: drawers and CLOSED/SCHEDULED lines are removed, while '** Summary', the body text and a ':ID:' line outside any drawer are kept. test_strip_drawers_leaves_blocks_and_unterminated_drawers checks that a #+begin_src block holding a :PROPERTIES:/:END:/CLOSED block comes back identical, and so does an unterminated :LOGBOOK: drawer. Src fences are still converted afterwards by the unchanged from_org_body.
